svg.data-join-cite: The Silmarillion, 'Of the Voyage of Eärendil and the War of Wrath': “In the east, in Ossiriand, the walls of Ered Luin were broken, and a great gap was made in them towards the south, and a gulf of the sea flowed in… That country had of old been named Lindon by the Noldor.”

g.data-placed: the frame of the join: this plate carries its own scale bar
g.title: The General Map of Middle-earth — Christopher Tolkien

g.data-title: Map of Beleriand and the Lands to the North
g.data-placed: joined at Ered Luin. Longitude from the range's western foot; scale from Sirion-to-Gelion, 100 leagues; latitude from the Gulf of Lune being the gap broken in this range, uncertain by ±52 miles
